He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Arizona State Sun Devils men's basketball|Arizona State Sun Devils]]. ==Early life and high school career== Christopher grew up playing basketball with his older brother, Caleb, in elementary school, middle school and his first two years with [[Mayfair High School]] in [[Lakewood, California]], as well as on the [[Amateur Athletic Union]] (AAU) circuit.{{cite web |last1=Turner |first1=Josiah |title=Josh Christopher's Family Tree Is Paving the Way for Success |url=https://www.si.com/college/2020/01/24/josh-christopher-recruiting-family |website=[[Sports Illustrated]] |accessdate=February 25, 2020 |date=January 24, 2020}}{{cite web |last1=Yeboah |first1=Eric |title=There's No Changing the One and Only Jaygup |url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2866574-dont-dismiss-jaygups-drip |publisher=[[Bleacher Report]] |accessdate=February 25, 2020 |date=December 13, 2019}} In his childhood, he often played against older opponents.{{cite web |last1=Sondheimer |first1=Eric |title=Sophomore guard Joshua Christopher is making basketball fun at Mayfair |url=https://www.latimes.com/sports/highschool/varsity-times/la-sp-joshua-christopher-sondheimer-20171221-story.html |website=[[Los Angeles Times]] |accessdate=February 25, 2020 |date=December 21, 2017}} As a sophomore at Mayfair, Christopher averaged 25.9 points, 6.5 rebounds, 4 steals and 3.6 assists per game, leading his team to a 21–8 record.{{cite web |last1=Ugland |first1=Devin |title=Mayfair boys basketball's Josh Christopher is a rising star |url=https://www.presstelegram.com/2018/01/06/mayfair-boys-basketballs-josh-christopher-is-a-rising-star/ |website=[[Press-Telegram]] |accessdate=February 25, 2020 |date=January 6, 2018}} In his junior season, he averaged 25 points per game and won the Division 2AA championship.{{cite web |last1=John |first1=Andrew L. |title=Star recruit Josh Christopher trying to enjoy every moment of his basketball journey |url=https://www.desertsun.com/story/sports/basketball/2018/12/28/josh-christopher-trying-enjoy-every-moment-his-basketball-journey/2429945002/ |website=[[The Desert Sun]] |accessdate=February 25, 2020 |date=December 28, 2018}} As a senior, Christopher was joined by Dior Johnson, one of the highest rated sophomores in the country. He averaged 29.2 points, 8 rebounds, 3.9 assists and 3.1 steals per game, leading his team to the [[CIF Southern Section]] Division 1 quarterfinals.{{cite web |last1=Jordan |first1=Jason |title=SI All-American Josh Christopher Highlights |url=https://www.si.com/college/recruiting/basketball/josh-christopher-mayfair-highlights-2020-si-all-american |website=[[Sports Illustrated]] |accessdate=April 13, 2020 |date=April 1, 2020}}{{cite web |last1=Divens |first1=Jordan |title=MaxPreps 2019-20 High School Boys Basketball All-American Team |url=https://www.maxpreps.com/news/nm9MAVtXhkuj_dSz8iO6PA/maxpreps-2019-20-high-school-boys-basketball-all-american-team.htm |publisher=[[MaxPreps]] |accessdate=April 13, 2020 |date=March 25, 2020}} Christopher was selected to play in the [[2020 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|McDonald's All-American Game]], [[Jordan Brand Classic]] and [[Nike Hoop Summit]], but all three games were canceled due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic|coronavirus pandemic]].{{cite web |last1=Jordan |first1=Jason |title=McDonald's All American Game Cancelled Amid COVID-19 Concerns |url=https://www.si.com/college/recruiting/basketball/mcdonalds-all-american-covid19-coronavirus-ncaa-tournament |website=[[Sports Illustrated]] |accessdate=March 30, 2020 |date=March 12, 2019}} ===Recruiting=== Christopher is a consensus five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and the number two [[shooting guard]] in the 2020 recruiting class. On April 13, 2020, he announced his commitment to [[Arizona State Sun Devils men's basketball|Arizona State]] over [[Michigan Wolverines men's basketball|Michigan]], [[USC Trojans men's basketball|USC]], [[Missouri Tigers men's basketball|Missouri]] and [[UCLA Bruins men's basketball|UCLA]]. His brother, Caleb, was heavily involved in recruiting Christopher to Arizona State even though Caleb is purely a bench and team player. As such, Christopher became Arizona State's highest-ranked recruit in the modern recruiting era and the program's first five-star recruit since [[James Harden]] in 2007.{{cite news |last1=Borzello |first1=Jeff |title=Arizona State lands top-10 senior Josh Christopher |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/29032374/arizona-state-lands-top-10-senior-josh-christopher |accessdate=April 14, 2020 |work=[[ESPN]] |date=April 13, 2020}} {{College Athlete Recruit Start|40=no|collapse=no|year=2020}} {{College Athlete Recruit Entry | recruit = Josh Christopher | position = [[Shooting guard|SG]] | hometown = [[Carson, California|Carson, CA]] | highschool = [[Mayfair High School|Mayfair]] (CA) | feet = 6 | inches = 5 | weight = 215 | 40 = | commitdate = April 13, 2020 |scout stars = |rivals stars = 5 |247 stars = 5 |espn stars = 5 |espn grade = 95 }} {{College Athlete Recruit End | 40 = | year = 2020 | rivals ref title = Arizona State 2020 Basketball Commitments | scout ref title = | espn ref title = 2020 Arizona State Sun Devils Recruiting Class | rivals school = arizonastate | scout s = | espn schoolid = 9 | 247 overall = 8 | rivals overall = 12 | espn overall = 11 | accessdate = August 3, 2020 | bball = yes }} ==College career== On November 26, 2020, Christopher scored a career-high 28 points for Arizona State in an 83–74 loss to third-ranked [[Villanova Wildcats men's basketball|Villanova]].{{cite web |last1=Dunham |first1=Torrence |title=Freshman Josh Christopher paces ASU in first half against No. 3 Villanova |url=https://arizonasports.com/story/2461147/freshman-josh-christopher-paces-asu-in-first-half-against-no-3-villanova/ |website=[[KMVP-FM]] |access-date=July 26, 2021 |date=November 26, 2020}} As a freshman, he was limited to 15 games due to injury, and averaged 14.3 points, 4.7 rebounds and 1.4 assists per game. On March 31, 2021, Christopher declared for the [[2021 NBA draft]].{{cite web |title=Arizona State’s Josh Christopher declares for 2021 NBA Draft |url=https://arizonasports.com/story/2581535/arizona-states-josh-christopher-declares-for-2021-nba-draft/ |website=[[KMVP-FM]] |access-date=July 26, 2021 |date=March 31, 2021}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA player statistics legend}} ===College=== {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | style="text-align:left;"| [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21]] | style="text-align:left;"| [[2020–21 Arizona State Sun Devils men's basketball team|Arizona State]] | 15 || 15 || 29.7 || .432 || .305 || .800 || 4.7 || 1.4 || 1.5 || .5 || 14.3 {{S-end}} ==Personal life== Christopher is the youngest of four siblings, all of whom have played basketball.{{cite web |last1=Woods |first1=Erik |title=Josh & Caleb Christopher: Family Secret Sauce to Success, Part 1 |url=https://californiapreps.rivals.com/news/josh-caleb-christopher-family-secret-sauce-to-success-part-1 |publisher=[[Rivals.com|Rivals]] |accessdate=February 25, 2020 |date=September 9, 2018}} His brother, [[Patrick Christopher|Patrick]], played professionally, including a brief stint with the [[Utah Jazz]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). Patrick's godbrother is former NBA player [[Tayshaun Prince]]. Christopher's sister, Paris, played college basketball for [[Saint Mary's Gaels women's basketball|Saint Mary's]] but suffered a career-ending injury as a freshman.{{cite web |last1=Gorcey |first1=Ryan |title=History repeats itself with Christopher |url=https://247sports.com/college/california/Article/Cal-becomes-the-first-offer-for-2020-basketball-recruit-Joshua-Christopher-brother-of-former-Bea-74900524/ |publisher=[[247Sports.com|247Sports]] |accessdate=February 25, 2020 |date=June 26, 2017}} His brother, Caleb, plays collegiately for [[Arizona State Sun Devils men's basketball|Arizona State]]. Christopher's father, Laron, is a musician. His parents are devout [[Christianity|Christians]]. Christopher is often known as "Jaygup," a nickname created in his childhood. ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[https://thesundevils.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/josh-christopher/11520 Arizona State Sun Devils bio] *[https://www.usab.com/basketball/players/mens/c/christopher-joshua.aspx USA Basketball bio] {{DEFAULTSORT:Christopher, Josh}} [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:2001 births]] [[Category:African-American basketball players]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:Arizona State Sun Devils men's basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from California]] [[Category:McDonald's High School All-Americans]] [[Category:People from Lakewood, California]] [[Category:Shooting guards]]
